Creativity, personality, and a willingness to be part of the overall concept are what matter most.Our experienced entrance and sorting team will evaluate each outfit individually within the overall context of the event. The decision of the staff is final and binding.Guests who do not meet the dress code requirements will not be admitted to the event.Changing facilities and a cloakroom are available on site.
